messages:
maria-sec: FYI — SCIM provisioning failures started right after last night's KMS rekey at ~02:15 UTC. Multiple orgs hitting JWE decryption errors. Any insight?

devops-bot: alert: 47 failed provisioning attempts since 02:17 UTC — https://grafana.company/alerts/1234 :warning:

raj-iam: looking. quick grep shows repeated errors: 'jwe: unsupported alg header' and 'decrypt failed: no matching key'.

olivia-sre: can you paste a sample log and the assertion header payload?

raj-iam: logging snippet:```json
{"jwe_header": {"alg":"RSA-OAEP-256","enc":"A128GCM","kid":"projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/key/cryptoKeyVersions/2"}, "error":"decrypt failed"}
```

sam-platform: we rotated keys and rewrapped assertions with the new key version. the rewrap job also toggled OAEP-256 support (we defaulted to OAEP-256 in the new repro). did not expect some IdPs to send RSA-OAEP instead.

maria-sec: that explains mismatch. downside: when decrypt fails the downstream RBAC audit exporter bails and we lose deprov audit events for those attempts. need a fast mitigation plan.

olivia-sre: short-term: accept both alg values in the decryptor and log the exact header so we can map which IdPs send what. patch idea: allowed_algs = ["RSA-OAEP","RSA-OAEP-256"] and attempt both flows.

raj-iam: testing hotfix on staging now — patch will try to unwrap with matching kid first, then fallback to alternate ALG handling. also adding verbose header logs.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started for svc-idp-proxy v1.4.3-hotfix -> canary 10%

sam-platform: also open a vuln-triage/ops ticket. key rotation changed cipher preference; we need to update our rotation playbook, add a compatibility gate, and add unit tests for alg header variants.

maria-sec: agree. I'll create INCIDENT-2026 and assign audit gap, KMS playbook, and post-mortem owners. we should also add a metric: scim_decrypt_failures_by_alg.

raj-iam: staging passed. canary 10 -> 100% in 12m if no regressions. patch summary: accept legacy alg header, fallback decrypt attempt, verbose header logging to trace IdP behavior.

olivia-sre: :+1: monitoring dashboards updated. will watch RBAC audit emitter for missing events. please ping when canary completes.

maria-sec: thanks all — once canary clears, follow up with post-mortem and an action to add an automated compatibility check before any KMS rewrap. :eyes:
